tom_sales: Heads-up: MarlinPay (payments platform) wants a 10-business-day POC to validate two scenarios: a) merchant support routing + recommended action, and b) automated KYC field extraction from uploaded onboarding PDFs. They asked for a short prompt set, acceptance criteria, and a cost estimate. Can SE/ML draft baseline prompts + eval plan? cc @priya_se @nate_ml

priya_se: Sounds good. Quick clarifying Qs: input sizes for support messages and docs? Are we including OCR step or will they provide parsed text?

carla_cs: They said PDFs will be OCR'd to text by their pipeline, but may include OCR noise. Support messages avg 120 tokens; docs avg 800 tokens with multi-page docs. Concurrency target is low (10 rps) but bursty during onboarding windows.

priya_se: For POC let's keep a lean prompt inventory: 1) intent classifier (support category) 2) action suggester (next best action + confidence) 3) KYC extractor (fields: name, dob, tax_id, address, merchant_id) 4) short summary (1-2 sentences) 5) canonicalizer (normalize dates/numbers) 6) safety gate (PII scrub guidance). I can paste examples.

priya_se: ```
# intent classifier
System: You are a concise classifier. Respond with one of: {chargeback, payout_issue, onboarding, fraud, other}.
User: "{message}"
Assistant: <intent>
```

priya_se: ```
# action suggester
System: Given the customer message and intent, suggest a single next action from: {escalate, refund, request_docs, reset_credentials, route_to_ops}. Include a short rationale and a 0-1 confidence score.
User: "{message}"
Assistant: {
  "action": "request_docs",
  "rationale": "needs transaction proof",
  "confidence": 0.87
}
```

nate_ml: Note: keep output formats strict (JSON/one-token intents) to simplify validators. For KYC extraction we should allow fuzzy matching for OCR errors. Eval metrics: fields F1 (fuzzy match threshold), overall document extraction recall, and normalized field error rate. Suggest seed eval size: 150 docs for extraction, 200 messages for intent/action.

carla_cs: Acceptance targets request from the customer: intent acc >= 0.9, action precision >= 0.85, extraction F1 >= 0.86 for mandatory fields (name, tax_id, merchant_id). They also want p95 latency < 450ms.

nate_ml: Agree. For summaries aim for readability score + ROUGE-L > 0.42. We'll produce a short eval harness and run locally against a reserved small instance.

tom_sales: Token estimates? They asked for an order-of-magnitude monthly cost for 500 DAU with an average of 3 requests/day (mix of short support + doc extraction).

nate_ml: Rough calc: support requests ~150 tokens in/out = 300 tokens. Doc extraction request: 800 in + 200 out = 1000 tokens. Mix estimate: avg per request ~600 tokens. 500 DAU * 3 = 1500 requests/day -> 900k tokens/day -> ~27M tokens/month. Add evals and retries ~+20% -> ~32M tokens/month. At hosted price $0.00002/token -> ~$640/month. Dedicated quote TBD based on sustained throughput and EU residency.

carla_cs: Customer requires EU data residency and wants logs without raw PII. Can we enable on-the-fly redaction and only store hashes of identifiers?

priya_se: Yes. We'll run a redaction microservice pre-ingest and strip out/replace high-risk PII before logs. For the model path, set no logging and no debugging. Need Legal for the DPA addendum.

infra-bot: Note: For EU-hosted POC, provisioned cluster available in eu-west-1. Provisioning ETA 48h after approval.

priya_se: Proposed POC schedule (10 biz days):
- Day 0: Kick + sample collection (150 messages, 150 docs), legal intro
- Days 1-3: Prompt templates + quick tuning, seed eval runs (baseline metrics)
- Days 4-7: Integration with their ingestion, redaction, and console quotas; run load tests for bursts
- Days 8-9: Acceptance runs, final metrics, prepare handoff docs
- Day 10: Demo + runbook + cost estimate

carla_cs: Deliverables: prompt inventory (examples + strict output schema), eval report (metrics + failure cases), token burn + cost projection, runbook for redaction + deployment, suggested SLA to move to Dedicated.

tom_sales: Any blockers?

nate_ml: Need anonymized samples with OCR artifacts. Also confirm their max document size (pages).

carla_cs: I'll coordinate and loop in Legal for DPA. Also requesting approval for EU provisioning.

tom_sales: Thanks — I'll send this plan to MarlinPay and ask for the sample pack and legal contact. If we get samples today we can start prompt curation tomorrow. :thumbsup:

priya_se: ack

nate_ml: ack

carla_cs: ack

infra-bot: POC workspace created: https://console.redwood.ai/poc/MP-2104 (access instructions emailed to leads)
